<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0022026-09-0702-01-34" status="unreviewed">
               <milestone n="lo tsa ba dang rgya" unit="section"/>
         yang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsa ba</rs> dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3834">rgya</rs> na re lhan cig dmigs pa nges pa'i <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">he du</foreign> yang ma grub ste | lhas sbyin dang mchog sbyin lta bu gnyis tshes gsum gyi zla ba'am gyad kyi 'dor stangs la lta ba'i tshe lhas spyin gyi gzung cha zla ba dmigs kyang 'dzin cha mchog sbyin gyi shes pa ma dmigs pas gzung cha dmigs pa la 'dzin cha dmigs <pb n="18"/><lb n="18.1"/>pas khyab pa med pas so ||
         <mentioned>gzung cha dmigs pa la 'dzin cha thams cad dmigs mi dgos te | lhas sbyin nyid kyi 'dzin cha shes pa tsam dmigs pas chog go | des na phyogs chos grub bo zhe na|</mentioned>
         de lta na yang ma nges te gzung cha dang 'dzin cha tha dad pa'i steng du lhan cig dmigs nges kyi rtags 'jug pa ma khegs pas so ||
         de yang dper na sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyis sems can la gzigs pa'i tshe gzung cha sems can gyi shes pa dmigs pa na 'dzin cha <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">'bu ta</foreign> khong nyid kyi ye shes dmigs kyang de gnyis gcig tu ma song bas so ||
         gal te gcig na sems can nyin mongs ba dang bcas ba bzhin du <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">'bu ta</foreign> yang de ltar 'gyur bas 'bad pa don med par 'gyur ba dang | <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">'bu ta</foreign> spangs pa dang ye shes phul du byung bdang ldan pa bzhin du sems can yang de ltar 'gyur bas 'bad pa med par grol ba thob par thal bas so zhes zer te 
         <milestone n="byang skyabs" unit="section"/>
         <rs type="school">rnam bden pa</rs> ltar na gzung cha snang ba thams cad rang rang gi shes pa dang bdag gcig pas lhas sbyin gyis mchog sbyin gyi gzung cha zla ba nyid dmigs pa med do zhes 'dod pas so || zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3864">byang skyabs</rs> gsung ngo ||</seg></TEI>
